description: RUN-LOCK-1 scenario manifest (documentation). The run-lock eval is logic-driven: evals/core/run-lock/run.js builds synthetic harnesskit roots under .tmp/ with injected clocks and asserts against scripts/session.js + scripts/lease.js + scripts/harness-commit.js directly. This file documents the scenarios; the driver does not parse fixtures from here.

scenarios.asserts: no active runs => not ambiguous; protected write has no active context
HARNESSKIT_RUN_ID resolves to a valid owned run (authoritative)
overlapping path lease by a second session is refused
a grant bound to S1/run1 is NOT matchable by S2
env-bound run wins even when .current-run is repointed by another session
expired lease is cleaned up and scope is reclaimable
harness-commit precommitCheck stops when HEAD != base_head
legacy grant (no owner_session/run_id) still matches single-session
env-bound CAP-0 write proceeds despite an unrelated active writer when scopes don't overlap
>1 active run + no HARNESSKIT_RUN_ID => protected write blocked
